T_AEB uses the last -1 m/s^2 crossing traced back to -0.3 m/s^2; not raw IMU/GT jerk
Diagnostic GT jerk is stored in report.braking with its own recorder clock, raw signal, window and duration weighting
limitations: Stored canonical scalar/filter/aggregation are preserved
Calibration membership, measured response and causal attribution are separate claims
